newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 582,900 MT were off 52 percent from the previous week and 36 percent from the 4-week average.

Major increases reported for Japan (209,200 MT including 199,600 onnes in new sales, 54,800 tonnes in destination changes and 45,300 tonnes in cancelations), South Korea (112,100 MT including 9,600 in new sales and 157,500 tonnes in destination changes), Taiwan (96,900 MT), Mexico (88,700 MT), Israel (58,700 MT), Egypt (45,700 MT), and Malaysia (45,000 MT) were partially offset by decreases reported for unknown destinations (291,200 MT).

Exports of 1,225,300 MT were down 12 percent from the prior week's level, but up 14 percent from the 4-week average. Japan (334,500 MT), South Korea (326,300 MT), Taiwan (56,500 MT), Mexico (55,600 MT), Jordan (53,200 MT), and Egypt (45,700 MT) were the principal recipients.
